pages.title: Polymeriser
pages.text: A stirred vessel where small molecules link into chains thousands long - if nearly every bond forms.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the conversion and the temperature. The chains are 1/(1 − p) units long (Carothers): each polymer needs its length. Hotter is faster; above 420 K the reaction runs away.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 3 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Aramid Fibre, Nylon Fibre, Polymer Sheet.
